mines.mine: Colosseum Gold and Rare Earth Element (REE) Project
mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned development project in San Bernardino County, California, <10 km north of the Mountain Pass REE mine (similar geology). Historic open-pit gold mine operated 1988-1993 by LAC and Barrick, producing 344,000 oz. Technically simple open-pit restart envisaged in May 2026 BFS: 75 koz avg first 6 yrs, 102 koz peak year 6, 573 koz over 10.4 yrs; 55 koz of Inferred Mineral Resources within the pit shell not included in the Ore Reserve. REE upside: ~3,000 m REE-focused drilling complete (2026, expanded to 18 holes); specific gravity 2.8-3.1 g/cm3 aligning with gravity anomalies. 2026 gold drilling extended mineralisation NE of North Pit: 287.3 m @ 1.05 g/t Au (CM25-41), 214 m @ 1.06 g/t (CM26-42), both from surface, open at depth. US Government support at high levels for gold & REE developments. Legal: April 2026 NPCA proceedings named US federal agencies (not the company) re Colosseum; company states permitted activities continue under its Plan of Operations (valid existing rights). FID/construction targeted 2026. Other 100%-owned projects: Argos Strontium Project (4 patented claims, Cady Mountains, San Bernardino County) and Music Valley HREE Project (57 claims, 1,140 acres, Riverside County). [production_notes: No production - development stage. BFS plan: avg 75 kozpa first 6 years, 102 koz peak (year 6), 573 koz total over 10.4 years.
